🦀 Dioxus Experiments

A collection of Rust/WASM apps exploring UI patterns and data processing

🪷 LOTUS Wikidata Explorer

Browse natural product compounds with taxon references and Wikidata integration. Explore chemical data structures in an interactive knowledge graph.

🧮 JSON Counter

Analyze JSON files efficiently. Upload any JSON document and get field-by-field statistics on non-null values, with streaming support for large files.

📊 MGF Precursor Error

Investigate mass spectrometry data. Upload MGF files and visualize precursor mass errors in both absolute (Da) and relative (ppm) units.

👋 Hello World

Getting started template for building new Dioxus applications. A minimal, clean foundation for your next WASM project.

⚠️ About These Prototypes

These are experimental applications built with Dioxus to explore UI patterns, performance optimizations, and data processing workflows. They're hosted here at my own discretion.

If you're interested in hosting or collaborating on any of these projects, please reach out on GitHub. I'm always open to feedback and partnership opportunities.
